content_data.email_purpose: To outline key strategic recommendations for integrating accessibility into our European logistics operations, enhancing both compliance and operational efficiency.
key_points: Phased implementation plan with clear milestones over the next 18 months.
Proposed framework for 'Accessibility-First' supply chain design, including digital and physical touchpoints.
Identification of key technology integrations to support accessibility for employees and partners.
Review of current operational accessibility gaps across European hubs.
Impact assessment of enhanced accessibility on workforce productivity and market perception.
content_data.call_to_action: Please review the attached strategic overview and prepare for our discussion next week to finalize the initial implementation roadmap.
